title: One figure in docs/benchmarks/results.jsonl
description: Every row carries every field, in store.FIELDS order; null (or []) is unknown or does not apply. Only aggregates: no per-case data, chat or case ids, titles, paths or free text from a run folder.

id.description: sha1 of the row without its id, first 12 hex digits

kind.description: measured: a recall eval run; delta: a paired difference (candidate minus control); third_party: a figure copied from a publication

date.description: the day the run started; third_party: the day the figure entered the repo from its source

value.description: in the metric's unit (fractions 0 to 1); null when only a range is known, or for a withdrawal

ci.description: 95% bootstrap interval over cases (paired, for a delta)

range.description: lowest and highest value over repeats or as reported, when the values themselves are not known

system.description: recall, a baseline recall's harness ran (no memory, answer sessions only, whole history), or a third-party product or method

release.description: only when the product code is exactly that release tag's

model.description: the model under test: the agent, the notes writer, or the answer model

conditions.description: the benchmark's knobs, as registry.json declares them

pair.description: groups a control, its candidate and their deltas

varies.description: a pair's or a delta's declared differences between its arms: fields (code, model, corpus, date...) or conditions (conditions.arm); check fails on any other difference among the fields the arms must share

runs.description: run folder basenames under the private runs folder; never paths

source_detail.description: where in the source: a table, section or file

grade.description: third_party: vendor (by the system's maker, its own paper included), paper (a research paper's own method or baseline), independent (anyone else: a benchmark's authors, an audit), mixed (a leaderboard of both)

reported.description: third_party: the figure exactly as the source prints it

public.description: cleared for the README, docs and the site
